name: addon.complexity

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to analyze

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum issues returned, most severe first (counts cover all issues)

name: addon.create
description: Create a new WoW addon from a template

description: Detect dead code in a WoW addon (unused functions, orphaned files, etc.)

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to analyze

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum issues returned, most severe first (counts cover all issues)

description: Scan a WoW addon's Lua files for deprecated API calls

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to scan

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by category (e.g., spells, items, containers)

parameters.name: min_severity
parameters.description: Minimum severity: info, warning, or error

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to format

parameters.description: Only check formatting, don't modify files

parameters.description: Enable smart compression for AI agents

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to analyze

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum issues returned, most severe first (counts cover all issues)

parameters.description: Name of the addon to sync

parameters.name: flavors
parameters.description: WoW flavors to sync to (defaults to all)

parameters.name: dry_run

description: Run Busted unit tests on a WoW addon

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to test

description: Validate a WoW addon's .toc file for common issues

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to operate on

name: api.download
description: Download FrameXML from Townlong Yak and optionally refresh API definitions

parameters.name: build_id
parameters.description: Build ID to download (digits only, e.g., '64889'). Required.

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Where to extract the download. Defaults to <data_dir>/framexml/{version}

name: api.generate
description: Generate APIDefs Lua files from api_database.json for Mechanic (defaults to the repository's Mechanic/UI/APIDefs)

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Output folder for APIDefs (defaults to the repository's Mechanic/UI/APIDefs). Must be named 'APIDefs' unless allow_any_output_dir is set.

parameters.name: allow_any_output_dir
parameters.description: Allow an output folder that is not named 'APIDefs'

name: api.info
description: Get detailed information about a specific WoW API

name: api.list
description: List APIs by namespace or category

name: api.populate
description: Parse Blizzard API documentation and generate api_database.json

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Output path for api_database.json (defaults to data_dir)

name: api.queue
description: Queue API tests for in-game execution. After running this, /reload in WoW to execute tests.

parameters.name: apis
parameters.description: List of API names to queue for testing

name: api.refresh
description: Full refresh: parse Blizzard docs and regenerate all APIDefs in one step

parameters.name: source_path
parameters.description: Path to wow-ui-source repository root or Townlong Yak extract

parameters.name: allow_any_output_dir
parameters.description: Allow an output folder that is not named 'APIDefs'

name: api.search
description: Search WoW APIs by name pattern. Works offline (reads static definitions).

name: api.stats
description: Get statistics about available WoW APIs

name: assets.list
description: List asset files in an addon's assets_source and assets folders

name: assets.sync
description: Sync addon assets: convert PNG to TGA and copy other files from assets_source to assets; removes only files a previous sync generated; supports dry_run

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to sync assets for

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Report what would be converted, copied and removed without changing files

name: atlas.scan
description: Scan wow-ui-source for atlas icons and generate searchable index

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Output path for atlas_index.json (defaults to data_dir)

name: atlas.search
description: Search Blizzard UI atlas icons by name pattern (supports wildcards)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query for atlas icons (supports * wildcards)

parameters.name: include_files
parameters.description: Include source file paths in results

description: Add an entry to the addon's CHANGELOG.md

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category: Added, Changed, Deprecated, Removed, Fixed, Security

name: commands.list
description: List command schemas and mutation metadata

description: Get the latest reload and test metrics from the local history

description: Read bounded desktop overhead and optional explicitly selected addon snapshot

name: diagnostic.targets
description: List deterministic client/account/character/profile diagnostic targets

name: docs.generate

parameters.description: Output file path. Defaults to docs/cli-reference.md

description: Detect stale or broken documentation in a WoW addon

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to analyze

parameters.name: commits_threshold
parameters.description: Flag docs not updated in this many code commits

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum issues returned, most severe first (counts cover all issues)

name: env.status
description: Get Mechanic environment configuration and status

name: fencore-catalog
description: Get full catalog of FenCore logic domains and functions

description: Get detailed info about a specific FenCore function

description: Search FenCore functions by name or description

parameters.description: Search query (partial match on name or description)

description: Create an annotated git tag for an addon release

description: Creates a libs.json config file from currently installed libraries. ⚠️ Will NOT overwrite existing config unless overwrite=true is set.

description: Sync addon libraries based on libs.json config

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to sync

name: locale.extract
description: Extract potential localizable strings from addon code

name: locale.validate
description: Validate locale coverage against the enUS baseline

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of the addon to validate

name: lua.queue
description: Queue Lua code snippets for in-game execution. After running this, /reload in WoW to execute.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: List of Lua code snippets to execute. Each snippet should return a value.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Optional labels for each snippet (for easier identification in results)

name: lua.results
description: Get results from the last Lua eval queue execution

name: perf.baseline
description: Record a performance baseline measurement for an addon

name: perf.compare
description: Compare current performance against baseline and detect regressions

parameters.name: memory_threshold
parameters.description: Memory increase factor that triggers warning

parameters.name: cpu_threshold
parameters.description: CPU increase factor that triggers warning

name: perf.list
description: List all addons with performance baselines

name: perf.report
description: Generate a performance report showing history and trends

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of recent measurements to show

name: release.all
description: Preflight and run version bump, changelog, commit and tag; supports dry_run

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate and preview without changing files, index, commits or tags

name: research.query
description: Search the web for addon development information using Gemini with Google Search grounding

name: sandbox.exec
description: Execute Lua code in a restricted sandbox with WoW API stubs. User code sees only whitelisted globals (no os, io, package, debug, require, dofile, loadfile, string.dump or bytecode loading); runs for at most 30s and prints at most 256 KB.

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of addon to load before execution (looks in _dev_ folder)

parameters.name: load_stubs
parameters.description: Whether to load WoW API stubs

name: sandbox.generate
description: Generate WoW API stubs from APIDefs for sandbox testing. A namespace is regenerated in place; existing stubs are kept unless force is set or the APIDefs are newer.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Specific namespace to regenerate in place (e.g., 'C_Spell'); the other namespaces in an existing stubs file are kept. If not provided, generates all.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Regenerate all stubs even if they are newer than the APIDefs

name: sandbox.status
description: Get status of generated WoW API stubs

name: sandbox.test
description: Run an addon's *_spec.lua tests (Core/ and Tests/) in the restricted sandbox with WoW API stubs and the bundled busted-style framework. filter limits tests by name; failures are listed first.

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Name of addon to test (looks in _dev_ folder)

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only run tests whose full name contains this text (case-insensitive)

name: server.shutdown
description: Gracefully shut down the Mechanic Desktop server

name: sv.discover
description: Automatically discover SavedVariables paths for all WoW flavors

name: sv.parse
description: Parse a WoW SavedVariables file and extract !Mechanic data

name: system.pick_file
description: Open a native file picker dialog to select a file (Windows only)

name: tools.status
description: Check the status of development tools (luacheck, stylua, etc.)

name: version.bump
description: Update the version in a WoW addon's .toc file
